data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Alexandros, which means 'defender of the people'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with Saint Alexander of Alexandria, a bishop known for his courage and faith. The name Aleksander carries the meaning “Defender of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aleksander usually hope their child will grow to embody defender of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אלכסנדר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלכסנדר הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'מגן אלוהים' או 'אלוהים מגן ומשמר'. השם אלכסנדר מורכב משתי מילים: 'אלכס' שפירושו 'להגן' ו'אנדר' שפירושו 'אדם' או 'גבר'. השם אלכסנדר היה נפוץ בקרב מלכים ופילוסופים ביוון העתיקה, והוא מופיע גם בברית החדשה כחלק מהרקע ההיסטורי של האימפריה הרומית.

in_greek.name: Αλέξανδρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλέξανδρος προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'αλεξτήρ του Θεού' ή 'ο Θεός είναι ο προστάτης'. Το όνομα αυτό αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'αλέξ' που σημαίνει 'προστατεύω' και 'ανδρός' που σημαίνει 'άντρας' ή 'γυναίκα'. Ο Αλέξανδρος ήταν ένα από τα πιο δημοφιλή ονόματα στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και συνδέεται με τον μεγάλο βασιλιά Αλέξανδρο τον Μέγα, που κατέκτησε μεγάλο μέρος του γνωστού κόσμου.

in_latin.name: Alexander
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alexander originem habet in lingua Graeca, sed in Latina usitatum est. Significat 'defensor hominum' vel 'Tutator', quia ex duobus verbis constat: 'alexo', quod est 'protego' et 'andros', quod est 'homo' seu 'vir'. Hoc nomen apud Romanos et in Ecclesia primitiva frequenter invenitur, et est nomen sancti, qui fuerunt defensores fidei et Ecclesiae.

in_english.name: Aleksander
in_english.meaning: Defender of the people, Protector of mankind
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aleksander originates from the Greek name 'Αλέξανδρος' (Aléxandros), meaning 'defender of the people' or 'protector of mankind'. It is derived from the words 'alexein', meaning 'to defend' or 'to protect', and 'andros', meaning 'man' or 'warrior'. Aleksander has been a popular name among Christian cultures, symbolizing strength, courage, and spiritual protection. Historically, the name is associated with Saint Alexander, a 3rd-century pope and martyr.

data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Aleksander, with its roots in the Greek Saint Alexander, signifies bravery and defense of one's faith. The name inspires strength and courage to stand firm in beliefs and to stand up for others. Saint Alexander, who was renowned for his unwavering faith in the face of persecution, offers a powerful spiritual example for those who bear this name. The name is a reminder of the importance of standing strong against adversity and staying true to one's spiritual and moral convictions.

As a warrior for the faith, he stands strong against adversity and champions the cause of love and unity. His name inspires courage and hope in the face of challenge, reminding us of God's faithfulness and protection.
